measured_on: the flattened single-file crate raw/../bzip2_c2rust.rs, used IDENTICALLY by both sides; raw/bzip2_c2rust.rs.linemap.json maps each flattened line back to (original library file, original line)
include_rule: path whitelist over the translated bzip2 LIBRARY sources — the transpilation of the .c files the shipped Makefile links into libbz2.a

exclude.bzip2.rs: translated CLI *program*; inlined only because bzlib.rs takes eleven type aliases from it (crate::bzip2::BZFILE, Char, the darwin _Rune* types)
exclude.bzip2recover.rs: second translated program; not part of the library, not linked here
exclude.libfuzzer-sys, arbitrary, std: not translated code — note that matching lib.rs by BASENAME also matches dependencies' src/lib.rs, which is why the filter checks the full path

notes: crctable.rs and randtable.rs are in scope but hold only static tables (0 functions), so they add nothing to either denominator; llvm-cov omits them for that reason.
Both sides use this identical scope and the identical denominator.
